comments.text: Just to let everybody know, I am THAT neighbor. So many of you have had amazing things to say about me and the situation. I can let everyone know, I think about this and poor Jeffery all the time. This day broke me. Someone I considered a friend did the most awful thing that I can never wrap my head around.  There was a lot that the documentary didn’t cover. I had so many animals die under my care because of the limited necessities on the property and Ernest and Heather couldn’t have cared less about what I was dealing with. I have moved from the house I was living in neighboring that property. It haunts me to this day to see my family that still lives there. I pray no one, ever goes thru this. It truly changed me as a person and I don’t trust people much at all anymore. To know I let someone like that, so close to me, is completely unnerving and I never want to experience it again. I do go to therapy regularly and discuss the things I have dealt with. That mattress they brought JR out on, I had to walk past every single day. It was awful and I pray someday to get the visuals out of my head. Unfortunately, I think they are etched with me forever. I thank everyone for the kind words because in the immediate aftermath I got so much hate mail saying I was supporting a murderer. Nothing could have been further from the truth. Thank you everyone for your cares and concern. I appreciate them more than you’ll ever know.
